# USA:s rapportsäsong startar – Finnair med omvänd vinstvarning

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opens the US earnings season, with Wall Street banks and Domino's reporting the same day. The guests from ABG and Handelsbanken see macro still driving markets: oil and diesel crack spreads stay high, inflation risk persists and consumers are weak, as shown by LVMH's soft quarter and the luxury sector selloff. Stockholm held up despite an AI-driven selloff in South Korea; the main stock-specific news was Finnair's positive profit warning, Nordea's upgrade of AstraZeneca to buy and several other analyst rating changes. The guests also argue that bonds are attractive again and that Nordic banks remain a solid sector to own.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AZN — AstraZeneca | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Nordea switched to buy from sell with a SEK 1900 target; the guest also likes the stock long term and points to modest multiples and rotation into healthcare.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view: Nordea's new analyst upgraded to buy, target SEK 1900 against a share price near 1600 (about 19% upside). Guest view: modest multiples, a good long-term case, and money rotating into healthcare as a defensive structural-growth sector away from AI. The stock led OMXS30 today, up 2.7%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rotation back into AI/tech pulls flows out of healthcare
- if the pipeline or guidance disappoints
- if the valuation re-rates beyond modest multiples

> *"Bra uppgradering. Vi gillar ju AstraZeneca också. Alla spår rätt modesta multiplar, så vi tycker det är ett bra case långsiktigt."*

---

### 🟡 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

BNP Paribas upgraded to neutral from underperform, target SEK 580; shares outperforming the market.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view only: BNP Paribas raised its rating to neutral from underperform with a SEK 580 target. The stock rose more than the market after the upgrade. Hosts gave no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the order intake slows
- if BNP or other analysts downgrade again

> *"BNP Paribas höjer rekommendationen för Alfa Laval till neutral från underperform och riktkursen är 580 kronor."*

---

### 🟡 ORSTED — Ørsted | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Goldman Sachs downgraded to neutral from buy, target DKK 155.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view: Goldman Sachs cut its rating to neutral from buy with a DKK 155 target. The episode gave no further discussion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow
- if offshore wind project problems recur

> *"Goldman Sachs sänker rekommendationen för det danska energibolaget Örstedt till neutral från köp. Riktkursen är 155 danska kronor."*

---

### 🟠 VITR — Vitrolife | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up over 5% with no visible news; host says it is worth keeping an eye on today.

#### Reasoning

Host noted strong unexplained price action (+5%) with no news in the feed. This is a speculative momentum watch only, with no fundamental thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the move reverses without a catalyst emerging

> *"Noterar också att Vitrolife är en aktie som går väldigt bra upp över 5 % idag. Jag har inte sett några nyheter i flödet som förklarar den uppgången, men ändå värt att ha med sig in i dagen."*

---

### 🟠 FIA1S — Finnair | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Positive profit warning: revenue guidance raised to EUR 3.5-3.6bn on stronger demand despite costlier jet fuel; shares up 10%.

#### Reasoning

Finnair raised its guidance slightly on demand strength despite high jet fuel prices. The hosts called the adjustment small but said a change of direction in a pressured sector drives a strong share reaction. Jet fuel and distillate prices remain a risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if jet fuel and distillate prices rise further
- if demand weakens with consumer caution

> *"Finnair kom för en liten stund sedan och pratade om starkare efterfrågan än förmodat, trots dyrare flygbränsle."*
